system.description:
Artefact (battle axe +3; Galrim Stoneblessed's axe, the first clan weapon of Dul Khagul). You have Darkvision 120ft and Advantage on saves against poison, and you can't be knocked Prone. Once per day you may cast move earth or wall of stone, or call 2d4 dwarven Veterans who fight for you for an hour.

Drawback: a creature that isn't a dwarf and holds it makes a Will save each day or grows dwarf-like, losing 1 Charisma (a drain).

Destroyed: melted in the forge that made it.

Monsters & Treasure, Artefacts. Its save DC is 20 unless the entry says otherwise.
